name: aranis-mcp
description: Connect Codex to the Aranis remote MCP server for third-party risk, control gaps and assessment analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Vendors, risk scores and control gaps, from your Aranis organization.
interface.longDescription: Reads your organization's third-party risk data from Aranis: which vendors exist, how risky each one is and why, and which controls are missing or partial. Sign-in happens through Aranis with OAuth — there is no key to paste — and you choose which organization the access applies to. Read-only.
defaultPrompt: Quais fornecedores da minha organização estão sem avaliação concluída?
Qual é o risco do fornecedor X e o que puxa a nota para baixo?
Quais lacunas de controle aparecem com severidade alta?
